source: Pokémon Showdown trainer sprites (https://play.pokemonshowdown.com/sprites/trainers/), file list retrieved 2026-10-03. Images are loaded from Showdown's server at runtime, not bundled; © Nintendo / Creatures / GAME FREAK. Sun & Moon ('-gen7') art is used where Showdown has it. Verified to exist with scripts/check-trainer-sprites.mjs.
approximations: Golfer: Showdown has a single 'golfer' sprite; it is used for both male and female Golfers.
Backpacker: all Battle Tree Backpackers are female (Tree-Sets data); Showdown's 'backpackerf' sprite is not Sun & Moon art.

Office Worker, Rising Star, Sightseer, Youth Athlete, Bellhop, Firefighter, Aether Foundation, Pokémon Center Lady, Wally, Plumeria, Guzma, Kiawe, Mallow, Sina, Dexio: Showdown's default sprite for the class/character (no '-gen7' variant exists).

Gym Leaders (custom): the sprite from their most recent main-series game with 2D sprites, other than Let's Go: Black 2 and White 2 (Pokémon World Tournament designs; '-gen5bw2' / '-pwt' where Showdown keeps Black and White ones as the default), or Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire-style '-gen6' sprites for Hoenn where Showdown has them. Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl, Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon and Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire are 3D, so Showdown has no sprite from them.
